events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Commemorating the life and legacy of Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: A tribute to the enduring impact of a hip-hop icon whose voice still resonates.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi's Genius
angles.copy: Celebrating the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, a guitar hero who redefined rock music.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Abbey Road
angles.copy: The album that gave us that iconic zebra crossing cover. Still sounds fresh decades on.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th to the formidable Chrissie Hynde, still rocking with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our Kid, Liam Gallagher, is 54 today. Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Timeless Message
angles.copy: A timeless message of peace and unity, John Lennon's 'Imagine' album still inspires.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod changed music forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: We mark Global James Bond Day, commemorating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Licence To Thrill
angles.copy: Licence to thrill! Happy James Bond Day to all 007 fans.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese. Nobody does it better.

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Dive into the eclectic brilliance of The Beatles' 'White Album', a double LP still surprising listeners decades on.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Commemorating the life and unparalleled talent of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the showmanship and vocal power of Freddie Mercury, a true rock legend.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: The album that marked a creative turning point for The Beatles – 'Rubber Soul' is still a masterpiece.
